title: Python: `http.cookiejar` applies expired `Set-Cookie` to cookie store before policy validation (CVE-2026-124249)
description: A vulnerability in Python's http.cookiejar.CookieJar allows a server to delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared cookie jar by sending an expired Set-Cookie header. This occurs because the cookie jar deletes stored cookies based on the Domain and Path attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy first. The issue violates RFC 6265 section 5.3 requirements. The fix involves consulting the cookie policy before allowing an expired cookie to delete an existing one.
